  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  This item will be acted upon separately.

  PH-1  CRUSADE CHRISTIAN FAITH CENTER
  Public hearing to update findings from Dr. Symone Starr Parker, on behalf of Crusade Christian
  Faith Center, to change East Tamarack Avenue to Virgil Patterson Lane From East Buckthorn
  Street to the end of the Cul-de-sac, depicted in the enclosed site plan.

  Recommendation:
  1) Receive additional input from requestor;
  2) Receive public comments;
  3) Approve or deny additional information submitted by Dr. Symone Starr Parker
  on behalf of Crusade Christian Faith Center; and
  4) Direct the City Clerk to present the findings to the City Council at the
  appropriate meeting.

  PH-2  MARVIN ENGINEERING CO.
  Public hearing to update findings from Marvin Engineering Co. to change Grosvenor Street
  (between La Brea and West Beach Avenue) to Marvin Way, depicted in the enclosed site plan.

  Recommendation:
  1) Receive additional input from requestor;
  2) Receive public comments;
  3) Approve or deny additional information submitted by Marvin Engineering Co.;
  and
  4) Direct the City Clerk to present the findings to the City Council at the
  appropriate meeting.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING OTHER MATTERS

  Persons wishing to address the Advisory Committee for Naming and Renaming of a Public Facility or
  Street on any matter not elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Persons with
  complaints regarding City management or departmental operations are requested to submit those
  complaints first to the City Manager for resolution.

  ADVISORY COMMITTEE COMMENTS

  The members of the Advisory Committee for Naming and Renaming of a Public Facility or Street will
  provide oral reports to address any matters they deem of general interest to the public.

  ADJOURNMENT ADVISORY COMMITTEE

  In the event that today’s meeting of the Advisory Committee for Naming or Renaming of a Public Facility
  or Street is not held, agenda items will automatically be continued to the next regularly scheduled Advisory
  Committee meeting. If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, or need translation
  services, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (310) 412-5280 or FAX (310) 412-5533, One
  Manchester Boulevard, First Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All requests for special
  accommodations must be received 72 hours prior to the day of the Advisory Meeting.
